chat.myLabel: Today’s name tag — it changes at midnight
chat.placeholder: Anything at all — gone in a day (press ☆ to keep it)
chat.keepingTitle: Keeping it — it will not disappear
chat.keepTitle: Keep it (stays after the day is out)
chat.hint:
This is a place to speak under a one-day name tag — the name changes at midnight and your account stays hidden.
What you write here is gone in a day. To keep it, press ☆ (stays right here) or 📌 (moves it into a community post).
chat.emptyKept: Nothing is kept yet. Press ☆ on a line you want to keep.
chat.emptyAll: Nobody has said anything yet. You may leave the first line.
chat.alone: You are alone right now. {others}Leave something and the people who were here today will be told.
chat.err.empty: An empty line does not go out.
chat.err.tooMany: Take a break — that was too many.
chat.err.muted: You cannot speak at the moment.
chat.err.offline: The server could not be reached.
chat.moved: The line came over — the writer is open on the free board.
chat.reported: Reported — it went to the owner.
